profile_text.body:
Celestica is a Toronto-headquartered public company, traded under the ticker CLS, that describes itself as a technology leader with expertise in design, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and platform solutions. It says it engineers, designs and manufactures the backbone of AI and cloud technology, and that it enables critical data center infrastructure for AI, cloud and hybrid cloud while advancing technologies in high-growth markets. The company points to a global network and its team as the basis for helping customers pursue competitive advantage.

Its own framing places AI and cloud infrastructure at the center of what it builds, rather than presenting a standalone AI product line. The company is a for-profit public company with a registered SEC filing identifier, CIK 0001030894, and its website is celestica.com.
